head: Re-dispatch of round 2 (same owner result). This file supersedes the earlier round-2 file of 22:04:54. I re-verified everything independently at HEAD 666bd1e09, and the verdict is unchanged. TailscaleCommon.ps1, FrankenPhpManager.ps1, WindowsManagementManager.ps1 and tailscale_common.sh have no content change in 93f8de054..666bd1e09 or in the working tree. In windows.md that range changed only SPW-035, so SPW-042 is unchanged.
scope: D29 Tailscale management, Windows side (shell-windows leader's own work), with the review-round-1 fixes. This does not cover the earlier D27 /opt/core_node_trees investigation that reused this id.
diff_base: For the whole task: 74e7770bd, the last commit before the 2026-09-27 run. The round-2 delta: 7a23f57d0 (the round-1 state) to 93f8de054. Re-checked up to HEAD 666bd1e09. For the three code files, the working tree equals HEAD.
notes:
B1 (parity). SPW-042 says 'platform-only' for the Panel not-installed gate, but Linux does not have that gate.
- .claude/agents_shared/shell_parity/windows.md:46 (SPW-042) labels the whole row 'platform-only'. Its stated reason covers only the elevation wait, the help default and the ImagePath parsing. The row also records the new Show-TailscalePanel gate at TailscaleCommon.ps1:491-495: when Tailscale is not installed, it prints the not-installed message and opens nothing.
- Linux has no such gate, re-read at HEAD. scripts/shells/linux/common/tailscale_common.sh:311-334 ts_show_panel always prints both panel URLs and, on a desktop session, calls ts_open_url on the admin console (:323) without checking is_tailscale_installed first. Line :325 guards only the backend-state read. It never says Tailscale is not installed.
- The user's D29 text scopes restart and panel to 'if installed locally' (如果本机安装). Windows follows that, so the divergence is real, and the part to fix is on Linux.
- The comment at TailscaleCommon.ps1:483-485 is false: it says Linux ts_show_panel 'gates opening them the same way'.
- The report (reports/shell-windows.md:566) and the result say 'No new pending-linux row was left open'. That hides the gap from the orchestrator. TASKS.md has only the combined D29 row (:164) and no Linux align task for this gate.
-> Fix:
1. Split the Panel gate out of SPW-042 into its own row. Use either:
   a. pending-linux, with this exact counterpart request: '[shell-linux] align: tailscale_common.sh ts_show_panel: when ! is_tailscale_installed, print the not-installed notice (pointing at 97_install_tailscale.sh / the tailscale_menu.sh Install entry) and return before printing or opening any panel'. The orchestrator then adds that task to TASKS.md.
   b. Or a genuine platform-only reason that actually covers the Panel behavior.
2. Correct or remove the comment at TailscaleCommon.ps1:483-485.
3. Correct the 'No new pending-linux row' line in the report.
non_blocking:
Dot-source side effects are still open. This was already flagged in the shell-windows-9 r2 note 'for shell-windows-10'. The comment at FrankenPhpManager.ps1:9-13 says dot-sourcing is 'safe', but it is not:
- The param block at TailscaleCommon.ps1:28-36 runs in the caller's scope, so a pre-existing $Action is reset to ''. When there is no $Action yet, the new $Action/$PanelTarget variables keep their [string]/[ValidateSet] attributes, so a later script-level `$Action = 'x'` throws a validation error. This was verified in an earlier scratch PS 5.1 test.
- TailscaleCommon.ps1:40 now loads CommonFunc.ps1 into every FrankenPhpManager consumer: Step93/94/96/175, FrankenPhpCertificateManager and the start.ps1 files. That includes its OutputEncoding side effects.
- Nothing breaks today: none of the affected scopes assigns $action or $panelTarget, and FrankenPhpCertificateManager.ps1:301 is function-local.
-> Split the file into a param-less library, which FrankenPhpManager dot-sources, and a thin -Action entry script. At minimum, correct the 'safe' comment.

FrankenPhpManager.ps1:750-751: `& $tailscaleExe status 2>&1 | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0)` is a third, exit-code-based status probe. It existed before this task. Under the EAP=Stop that GlobalVars sets, a stopped daemon's stderr throws NativeCommandError in PS 5.1, so the [MANUAL] warning never prints. The spec also prefers BackendState to exit codes. -> Use `(Get-TailscaleStatusSummary -TailscaleExe $tailscaleExe).BackendState -ne $script:TailscaleRunningState`.

TailscaleCommon.ps1:457: after `Start-Process -Verb RunAs -Wait`, the message is always -Type 'Success', even when the elevated Restart-Service failed and the status read back is not Running. -> Choose Success or Warning from $afterStatus.Status.

Comments that describe code history, which AGENTS.md forbids (no progress summaries in source):
- FrankenPhpManager.ps1:74-75 describes a constant that was removed.
- TailscaleCommon.ps1:61-65 explains the old Trim('"').
- FrankenPhpManager.ps1:570-572 and :740-742 say 'instead of a second ... copy'.
-> Drop them, or state only the current behavior.

The 93f8de054 capture also carries a comment-only hunk at FrankenPhpManager.ps1:26-32 (the required-extensions comment no longer mentions the D7 hand-written ini). It is harmless, but the report does not list it.

Minor drift from Linux:
- The Windows menu has no Help value, while tailscale_menu.sh has one.
- Show-TailscaleHelp has no official-doc links, while ts_show_help does.
- An unquoted ImagePath with spaces is still split at the first space (TailscaleCommon.ps1:83-86). This is negligible because the MSI writes a quoted path.
verified_ok:
The round-1 blockers are fixed and re-read at HEAD:
- [AllowNull()] is on Get-TailscaleJsonProperty (TailscaleCommon.ps1:179). With $status/CurrentTailnet null, the summary returns BackendState 'Unknown' and PeerCount 0. NeedsLogin prints AuthURL and the up-hint.
- DNSName is in $columns (:414).
- FrankenPhpManager reuses Find-TailscaleExecutable (:743), Get-TailscaleStatusJson (:573) and Get-TailscaleJsonProperty (:574-575). No FrankenPhpTailscaleDefaultExePath is left, and grep finds no other Windows copy of the exe path, console URL or Quad100 URL.
- The Test-Path on the resolved TailscaleCommon.ps1 is gone from WindowsManagementManager.ps1.

Checked against the official-docs spec:
- Service name 'Tailscale'.
- Exe detection order: ProgramFiles, then PATH, then the Win32_Service PathName sibling.
- 'Installed' means both the exe and the service are present.
- BackendState is read from status --json.
- IPv4/IPv6 are split by ':'.
- The connection label order is CurAddr, then PeerRelay, then Relay.
- console.tailscale.com/admin/machines.
- Quad100 opens only when Running.
- 127.0.0.1:8384 / localhost:8088 / set --webclient are printed as text only.
- No install, and no up/down/set is run.
- When not installed, the message points at the MSI docs and the winget id. The repo has no Windows Tailscale installer script to point at.

Parity:
- Actions and dispatcher names match: Status|Devices|Restart|Panel|Help against status|devices|restart|panel|help.
- Device fields match ts_show_devices one for one: HostName, DNSName, Owner, OS, IPv4, IPv6, Online, LastSeen, ExitNode in-use/offered, Connection.
- The up-hint and the other-panels text match.
- TAILSCALE_SERVICE and is_tailscale_installed are each defined once, in tailscale_common.sh.

Parsers:
- PS 5.1 Parser::ParseFile reports 0 errors on TailscaleCommon.ps1, FrankenPhpManager.ps1 and WindowsManagementManager.ps1. All three have 0 CR bytes and 0 non-ASCII bytes.
- bash -n passes on tailscale_common.sh and tailscale_menu.sh.
Tailscale was not restarted: both tailscaled processes still have StartTime 2026-09-27 14:38:01, tailscale-ipn 14:38:31, and the service is Running/Automatic.

No running-plan file was edited. The dd.sh startup-refactor files that differ from 74e7770 (dd.sh, dd_helper/*) come from other lanes and header-cleaner removals, not from this task. This task's files are the 3 Windows .ps1 files, windows.md, reports/shell-windows.md and reviews/shell-linux-11.json (the leader's r2 verdict, a leader duty).

The menu (WindowsManagementManager.ps1) keeps Repair Disk, Linux Dual Boot Readiness and Organize Desktop Icons. The Tailscale entry maps status/devices/restart/panel through one table ($script:TAILSCALE_ACTIONS) and runs the common with -File. It is idempotent. Restart elevates only on demand.
